title: Arrival Of Japanese Consul General

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G. 40M. 1. 36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    Misc.    File No. 495.
                                Wayside Station,
            REPORT              Date Oct. 31, 19 36.

Subject Arrival of Japanese Consul General.

Made by D.S.I. Cumming.    Forwarded by

Sir,
    Mr. Suma, Japanese Consul General at Nanking, arrived from
Japan at the China Merchants Lower Wharf on board the S.S.
"Aramis" at 10 a.m. 31.10.36.
    The usual police precautions were taken but no untoward
incident occurred.

                                D.S.I.

FILE
（批：D.Dro."B"
      b.e. (S.S).）

                                路边警亭，
            报告                日期 1936 年 10 月 31 日。

主题：日本总领事抵达。

由副督察长卡明（Cumming）呈报。    转呈者

阁下，
    日本驻南京总领事须磨先生（Mr. Suma）于 1936 年 10 月 31 日上午 10 时乘“阿拉米斯”号轮船（S.S. "Aramis"）从日本抵达招商局下栈码头。
    已采取常规警务预防措施，未发生任何意外事件。

                                副督察长

FORM NO. 3
G. 459. I. 36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 455/36,
Wayside Station, 755
Date Oct. 6, 1936.

REPORT

Subject Arrival of Mr. Kuwajima.

Made by D.S.I. Cumming. Forwarded by

Sir,
Mr. Kuwajima, Director of the Asiatic Section of the
Japanese Foreign Office arrived at the O.S.K. Wharf at 3.40 p.m.
5-10-36 by the S.S. "Nagasaki Maru". Police precautions were
taken but no untoward incident occurred.

D.S.I.

（批：file / 3/1）

D.D.O. "D".

O.i/c Special Branch.
